stories.title: Verstappen's Exit Clause Sits Active — Red Bull's $80M Counter-Offer Gets No Response

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: Red Bull reportedly offered Verstappen $80M/year through 2029 — with the performance clause REMOVED. His management has not formally responded. The exit clause is active. The October deadline is set. The silence is deafening. #F1Fanrecap

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: Verstappen's manager says he "wants to fulfill his Red Bull contract." Red Bull tables an $80M/yr retention offer. Max still hasn't responded. McLaren is waiting. Zandvoort is in 23 days. Something has to give. #F1Fanrecap

stories.title: Aston Martin's B-spec Breakthrough Is Real — And It Might Change Alonso's Decision

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text: Fernando Alonso made Q2 for the first time all season at Hungary. The Aston Martin B-spec works — 16-part upgrade, 2% lap time gain. Alonso: "That adrenaline... was missed." Newey says more steps at Zandvoort, Monza, Baku. Retirement who? #F1Fanrecap

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text: Alonso was supposed to decide about retirement during summer break. Then his car made Q2 for the first time all season. Then Adrian Newey said more improvements are coming. Decisions get harder when the car starts working. #F1Fanrecap

stories.title: F1's Season Finale May Not End in Abu Dhabi — Portugal and Italy Are in the Mix

x_posts.label: Post 5-1
x_posts.text: F1 already lost Bahrain and Saudi Arabia this season. Now Qatar (Nov 29) and Abu Dhabi (Dec 6) are at risk too. Domenicali confirmed contingency plans — Portimão is primary, Imola is an option, Las Vegas is NOT the finale. The title fight could end anywhere. #F1Fanrecap

x_posts.label: Post 5-2
x_posts.text: Imagine the 2026 F1 World Championship being decided at Portimão. Or Imola. The Middle East situation is making it a genuine possibility. Domenicali has confirmed alternatives exist. The season finale may not look like anyone planned. #F1Fanrecap
